name: Manufacturing robot cell safety
description: Reference Trust Requirements Profile for a manufacturing robot cell. Illustrative draft values, not certified safety limits.

scope.intended_use: Trust requirements for one collaborative robot cell operating near people.
scope.boundary: A single collaborative robot cell and its immediate safety envelope.
out_of_scope: How the system is scored against these signals
How a halt or other action is enforced

scored_signals.reason: Human proximity overrides normal productivity goals.
High speed increases risk and can indicate command drift.
High vibration can mean collision, wear, or a loose part.
Overheating can damage equipment and cause unsafe behavior.
Low confidence means the action should not be blindly trusted.
Stale, missing, or noisy data should reduce trust.

standing_bands.range: all signals within acceptable operating range and no hard rule met
one or more signals in the warning range
a signal in the critical range or a hard rule met

required_standing.source_requirement: For audit or insurance use, the evaluation source should be independent.

notes: Threshold values are illustrative draft values, not certified safety limits.
Standing bands describe how standing is expressed; they do not define how it is computed.
This profile is a reference template. Real deployments should set values to their environment and applicable safety practice.
